QF.id: Role of RTAs in Mutual Fund Transactions_26

question.text: What is the NAV publication deadline for Fund of Fund (FoF) schemes?

answer.text: 9 AM on the next business day (T+1)
12 noon on the next business day (T+1)
10 AM on the next business day (T+1)
11 PM on the same business day (T-day)

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook prescribes a later NAV deadline of 10 AM on the following business day for Fund of Fund schemes, because the FoF NAV depends on the underlying scheme NAVs that are themselves published earlier the same evening. The Trap: The standard 11 PM same-day deadline applies to most other mutual fund schemes, but not to FoF schemes. Do not generalize the 10 AM T+1 deadline to other scheme types unless a current SEBI source explicitly says so. Note: The 10 AM T+1 rule is workbook-supported only for Fund of Fund schemes. Any further category exceptions should be verified against the latest SEBI circular before relying on them.
